description: A simple Paper plugin that lets players teleport between world spawn and their bed. Teleportation is restricted - players must be within predefined distance from either bed or spawn.
body:
# Goto Spawn

## Description
A simple Paper plugin that lets players teleport between world spawn and their bed using the /goto command. Teleportation is restricted - players must be within 16 blocks of the destination anchor point.

The reason for such limitations is to preserve the vanilla feel and at the same time provide easy access to the common area.


## Usage

`/goto spawn` - Teleports to world spawn (must be within 16 blocks of your bed)

`/goto bed` - Teleports to your bed (must be within 16 blocks of world spawn)

Players must have a bed or respawn point set for either subcommand to work.


## Issues
